description: MetaCryst is Metaguise's newest facade innovation - a modular, custom-engineered 3D faceted metal panel system. Each panel's faceted geometry catches light and shifts with perspective, turning flat surfaces and under-ceilings into sculpted, dimensional compositions. Built for projects that call for depth, reflection, and a strong architectural identity, MetaCryst brings a distinctive, light-responsive texture to any architectural solution.
